title: How Facebook's Algorithmic Tweaks Affected Engagement with News URLs over Time
snippet: A liveblogged review of Fabio Giglietto's research presentation at the International Communication Association (ICA) conference in Cape Town. It covers Giglietto's findings on partisan alignment, news quality (using NewsGuard ratings), and Facebook's shifting algorithmic governance designs over a six-year period.
description: A liveblogged review of Fabio Giglietto's research presentation at the ICA conference in Cape Town, analyzing how Facebook's algorithmic changes affected user engagement with news URLs over time.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: An Italian regional news feature covering the public and political impact of Fabio Giglietto's study ('A Pretty Blunt Approach'). The piece outlines how Giglietto's research on algorithmic bias was highlighted on the investigative television show 'Report' on Rai3 and subsequently triggered a formal inquiry in the European Parliament.
description: An Italian news article discussing the political and public impact of Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithmic bias, which was featured on public television and triggered a European Parliament inquiry.

title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: A news article detailing the findings of Professor Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's algorithmic filtering. It explains how institutional political voices lost massive visibility online, while extremist and anti-establishment channels succeeded in maintaining or growing their reach by increasing posting frequency.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.
